description: You are a management consultant preparing a quarterly board presentation for Vertex Dynamics Corp, a mid-market industrial manufacturing company. Open /home/ga/Documents/quarterly_raw.docx, which contains raw departmental performance data from Q3 2024 that was dumped from various department heads' email updates. The data is entirely unformatted paragraphs with financial figures, KPIs, and strategic notes mixed together. Transform this into a professional quarterly board report: create a centered bold title and subtitle, write an executive summary section synthesizing the key findings from all departments, build a financial performance table showing Revenue, COGS, Gross Margin, Operating Expenses, and Net Income with Q3 actual vs. budget vs. prior year columns, create a KPI dashboard table showing 8+ metrics with actual values, targets, and status indicators, add a strategic recommendations section with a prioritized action matrix table (High/Medium/Low priority with timeline and owner), ensure proper heading hierarchy throughout, and format the entire document professionally with consistent styling. Save the formatted document.

metadata.data_source: Fictional mid-market manufacturer based on typical industrial company quarterly reporting patterns
